what.question: What is MyrmAgent?
what.answer: MyrmAgent is an AI agent platform with a persistent sandbox, memory system, and GUI-first interface. It helps you research, code, and automate tasks without managing infrastructure.

pronounce.question: How do you pronounce MyrmAgent?
pronounce.answer: /ˈmɜːrm ˈeɪdʒənt/. Myrm comes from the Greek word for ant — the same root as myrmecology and our Colony Agents multi-agent metaphor.

local.question: Can I use my own API keys?
local.answer: Yes. Bring Your Own Key (BYOK) is supported — you pay your LLM provider directly for those calls while still using the full MyrmAgent workspace.

data.question: Where is my data stored?
data.answer: Your workspace data stays in an isolated environment under your control — persistent memory, files, and sessions are not shared with other users. See our Privacy Policy for details.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy describes how VortexAI ("we", "us") collects, uses, and protects information when you use the MyrmAgent website (myrmagent.ai), MyrmAgent Cloud (app.myrmagent.ai), and self-hosted local or desktop deployments.

collection.title: Information We Collect
collection.body: When you visit myrmagent.ai, we may collect basic access logs and support correspondence. For MyrmAgent Cloud, we collect account information from OAuth sign-in (email, profile name, provider subject ID), subscription and Work Units billing records via Creem (our merchant of record), and workspace data stored in your dedicated cloud sandbox volume. Local WebUI and Tauri desktop deployments keep workspace data (memory, files, sessions) on your device or servers by default — we do not collect it unless you use cloud hosting.

usage.title: How We Use Information
usage.body: We use this information to improve the website, respond to support requests, and communicate about product or security matters. We do not sell personal data to third parties.

storage.title: Data Storage & Security
storage.body: MyrmAgent Cloud stores workspace data in an isolated per-user sandbox volume with encryption at rest. It is not shared with other tenants. Local WebUI and Tauri desktop deployments keep data on your device or your servers. API keys are stored in an encrypted secrets vault when configured in the app. Payment data is processed by Creem; we do not store full card numbers.

sharing.title: Third-Party Services
sharing.body: When you configure API keys and call models, requests are sent to your chosen LLM providers. Cloud subscriptions and billing are processed by Creem. OAuth sign-in may use Google or GitHub. Each provider receives only the data necessary for its service.

rights.title: Your Rights
rights.body: You may request access, correction, or deletion of your account data by contacting support@myrmagent.ai. EU/UK users may exercise GDPR rights; California users may exercise CCPA rights.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: VortexAI operates the MyrmAgent platform. These Terms govern your use of MyrmAgent local and desktop deployments, and MyrmAgent Cloud hosted at app.myrmagent.ai.

acceptance.title: Acceptance
acceptance.body: Using MyrmAgent constitutes acceptance of these terms. If you do not agree, do not use the service.

service.title: Service Description
service.body: VortexAI operates MyrmAgent, an AI agent platform with free self-hosted local WebUI and desktop deployments (BYOK), and optional MyrmAgent Cloud — a hosted SaaS with per-user isolated sandboxes, Work Units usage billing, and 24/7 uptime. Features and availability may change with reasonable notice.

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.body: Cloud accounts are created via OAuth (Google or GitHub). You are responsible for account security. Abuse, credential sharing, automated account farming, or attempts to bypass Work Units limits may result in suspension. For local or desktop deployments, you are responsible for account and API key security.

billing.title: Billing
billing.body: Local WebUI and Tauri desktop are free to use with BYOK — you pay your LLM provider directly for API calls. MyrmAgent Cloud offers subscription plans billed through Creem with Work Units (WU) usage allowances. See our Refund Policy for cancellation and refund terms.

disputes.title: Support
disputes.body: For product or support questions, contact support@myrmagent.ai. We respond within 2 business days.

acceptableUse.title: Acceptable Use
acceptableUse.body: You may not use MyrmAgent for illegal activity, malware, spam, or attempts to bypass usage limits. We reserve the right to suspend accounts that violate this policy.

liability.title: Limitation of Liability
liability.body: MyrmAgent is provided "as is" without warranties. We are not liable for indirect damages. Our total liability is limited to fees paid in the 12 months preceding the claim.

refund.title: Refund Policy
refund.intro: VortexAI operates MyrmAgent. This Refund Policy applies to MyrmAgent paid subscription plans billed through Creem.

overview.title: Overview
overview.body: Subscriptions renew automatically until cancelled. You may cancel at any time from your account settings or Creem customer portal.

trial.title: Free Tier
trial.body: The Free plan includes 600 Work Units per month plus a daily refresh. No payment is required. Free tier abuse prevention may apply.

proTrial.title: Pro Free Trial
proTrial.body: The Pro plan includes a 7-day free trial for eligible new subscribers. Cancel before the trial ends to avoid charges. If not cancelled, the subscription converts to a paid plan and billing begins automatically when the trial ends.

cancellation.title: Cancellation
cancellation.body: When you cancel, your plan remains active until the end of the current billing period. No further charges will occur after cancellation.

refunds.body: Monthly subscriptions are generally non-refundable once the billing period begins. If you believe you were charged in error, contact support@myrmagent.ai within 7 days.

disputes.title: Payment Disputes

For Creem-mediated disputes, we submit subscription agreement and usage evidence. Fraudulent chargebacks may result in account suspension.

Working Memory resumes tasks; eager memory_recall + conversation_search tools recall history on demand (Sources-verifiable); one-click save any reply to long-term memory; real-time toast when preferences are auto-extracted with one-click to review; memory conflicts auto-detected and routed to you for arbitration (keep / replace / merge / discard) with 72h safe fallback; wiki with 3D graph and HITL review grounds answers.

deepResearch.label: Search & research
deepResearch.title: Deep research with local-first crawling
deepResearch.desc: Multi-engine search, local fetch tiers, and cited reports — 4 source types (web/MCP/knowledge base/history) with inline popover previews. Pause anytime, budget always visible.

desktopComputerUse.label: Silent Desktop Agent
desktopComputerUse.title: Working for you, never stealing your mouse
desktopComputerUse.desc: Pioneering focus-free background MCP execution. You attend meetings while it operates apps—truly zero interference. Built on @dref semantic accessibility trees with vision fallback for 100% precision even after drastic UI changes. Plus, military-grade guardrails block dangerous deletions and sensitive app access to protect your digital assets.

multiAgent.label: Multi-agent
multiAgent.title: A team of agents — with you as boss
multiAgent.desc: 8 orchestration modes auto-decompose tasks; COW isolation ensures concurrency safety; 3-tier sandbox starts without Docker. Opt-in 6 LLM delegation tools (0 tok by default) + REST Dashboard dual control. ACP protocol delegates to Claude Code/Codex/Gemini or any external agent. Background sub-agents with async wakeup + CatchupInbox notifications. Adversarial verifier + Council mode. Real-time DAG topology + cancel/steer/resume + Durable Dynamic Workflow + 4-layer cost protection — 366+ subagent regression + Jul 2026 server API integration verified.

omniChannel.label: Channels & automation
omniChannel.title: Same agent on chat, voice, and cron
omniChannel.desc: Messaging platforms, webhooks, and scheduled jobs — push work from your phone, get instant acknowledgment. When a long Web task finishes, the agent can push summaries + attachments to Telegram/Slack you picked in settings (whitelist + reliable delivery). Scheduled checks stay silent when all clear — only bothers you when action is needed. Enterprise Agent Marketplace lets teams share best configs in 1 click — auto-strips credentials on publish, bundles Skill/MCP/SubAgent deps on install, admin force-push updates to all installed users instantly. New hires onboard in 5 min.
omniChannel.tag2: Zero noise · notify only when needed

billing.question: How does Work Units (WU) billing work?
billing.answer: You see a single Work Units balance. Platform usage — LLM calls, tool execution, and active sandbox time — burns WU according to an internal rate table. Idle sleep periods incur zero WU cost. BYOK is supported where applicable.

data.question: Where is my data stored?
data.answer: Cloud data lives in an isolated per-user sandbox volume with encryption at rest. It is not shared with other tenants.

cancel.question: Can I cancel anytime?
cancel.answer: Yes. Subscriptions cancel anytime; access continues until the billing period ends. See our Refund Policy.

selfHost.question: Prefer to self-host?
selfHost.answer: MyrmAgent is open source. Run Local WebUI or the desktop client on your own hardware — forever free with BYOK.

topup.question: Can I buy extra Work Units?
topup.answer: Yes. One-time WU top-ups are available in the app billing page when you need more capacity before your monthly reset.

byok.question: Does BYOK work on cloud?
byok.answer: Yes. Bring your own API keys where supported — platform WU still applies to sandbox time and bundled tool usage per plan.

sandboxSpec.question: What sandbox specs do I get?
sandboxSpec.answer: Companion and Plus include a 2C sandbox (4GB RAM, 50GB storage); Pro adds 8C with VNC desktop (8GB RAM, 100GB storage); Max includes 8C with 200GB storage and the highest monthly WU allowance.
